config.call: one distinct subset read per pool (memoized); empty and full sets count when read
config.greedy_ties: BM25 retrieval rank (credits.retrieval_rank, -rank): forward adds the better-ranked memory, backward drops the worse-ranked one; the *_tiemean rows average over uniform random tie-breaks instead. Pool bit order is chronological.
config.labels: memcredit_analyze.h2_verdict: MISSPECIFIED if the 99% lower bound > 0.05, ADEQUATE if the 99% upper bound < 0.02, else INCONCLUSIVE (descriptive here)
config.nonconstant_rule: a table counts when its 256 values are not all equal (AM1's summary.constant is False; exactly the tables with a committed regret field)
config.regret: harness.memcredit.keep_set_regret_range mean (uniform over tie sets); search rules through their keep set's indicator
